L240:   * cite92†Access Control L241: ## Intro and Usage
L242: 
L243: The `wayback-cdx-server` is a standalone HTTP servlet that serves the index that the `wayback` machine uses to lookup captures.
L244: 
L245: The index format is known as 'cdx' and contains various fields representing the capture, usually sorted by url and date. cite93†http://archive.org/web/researcher/cdx_file_format.php†archive.org L246: 
L247: The server responds to GET queries and returns either the plain text CDX data, or optionally a JSON array of the CDX.
L248: The CDX server is deployed as part of web.archive.org Wayback Machine and the usage below reference this deployment.
L249: 
L250: However, the cdx server is freely available with the rest of the open-source wayback machine software in this repository.
L251: 
L252: Further documentation will focus on configuration and deployment in other environments.
L253: 
L254: Please contant us at wwm@archive.org for additional questions.
L255: ### Basic Usage
L256: 
L257: The most simple query and the only required param for the CDX server is the url param
L258: 
L259:   * cite94†http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=archive.org†web.archive.org L260: 
L261: The above query will return a portion of the index, one per row, for each 'capture' of the url "archive.org" that is available in the archive.
L262: 
L263: The columns of each line are the fields of the cdx. At this time, the following cdx fields are publicly available:
L264: `["urlkey","timestamp","original","mimetype","statuscode","digest","length"]`
L265: 
L266: It is possible to customize the cite77†Field Order as well.
L267: 
L268: The the url= value should be cite95†url encoded†en.wikipedia.org if the url itself contains a query.
L269: 
L270: All other params are optional and are explained below.
L271: 
L272: For doing large/bulk queries, the use of the cite75†Pagination API is recommended.
L273: ### Url Match Scope
L274: 
L275: The default behavior is to return matches for an exact url. However, the cdx server can also return results matching a certain prefix, a certain host or all subdomains by using the matchType= param.
L276: 
L277: For example, if given the url: archive.org/about/ and:
L278: 
L279:   * matchType=exact (default if omitted) will return results matching exactly archive.org/about/
L280: 
L281:   * matchType=prefix will return results for all results under the path archive.org/about/
L282: cite96†http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=archive.org/about/&matchType=prefix&limit=1000†web.archive.org L283: 
L284:   * matchType=host will return results from host archive.org
L285: 
L286: cite97†http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=archive.org/about/&matchType=host&limit=1000†web.archive.org L287: 
L288:   * matchType=domain will return results from host archive.org and all subhosts *.archive.org
L289: 
L290: cite98†http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=archive.org/about/&matchType=domain&limit=1000†web.archive.org
